title: Patient Financial Assistance Program Service Standards: Document Deadlines, Extensions and Decision Times
content:
The Patient Financial Assistance Program sets, for every tier, the time an applicant has to supply requested documents, how far one extension moves that deadline and how many extensions a case may receive, and how quickly a complete application is decided and the decision letter sent.

| Tier | Documents due, calendar days after the request | Days added by one extension, calendar days | Extensions allowed per case | Decision, business days after the application is complete | Decision letter, business days after the decision |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Financial Assistance 25% Discount | 30 | 15 | 1 | 10 | 5 |
| Financial Assistance 50% Discount | 30 | 15 | 1 | 10 | 5 |
| Financial Assistance 75% Discount | 30 | 15 | 1 | 10 | 5 |
| Financial Assistance Full Discount | 30 | 15 | 1 | 10 | 5 |
| Presumptive Eligibility Full Discount | 30 | 15 | 1 | 2 | 5 |
| Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment | 30 | 15 | 1 | 15 | 5 |

## What the figures mean

- **Documents due days** is the tier's figure of calendar days after the documents are requested by which they must be received: 30 for every tier.
- **Document extension days** is the tier's figure of calendar days one extension adds to the document due date: 15 for every tier.
- **Extensions allowed per case** is 1 for every tier.
- **Decision time** runs in business days from the date the application is complete: 2 for the Presumptive Eligibility Full Discount, 15 for the Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment, and 10 for each of the four income tiers.
- **Decision letter** goes out within 5 business days after the decision for every tier.

Calendar-day figures and business-day figures are not interchangeable: the first two columns count calendar days; the last two count business days.
